title: HF94 (2021-2022 Regular): Non-in-person permit to carry renewal authorized.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2021-01-14; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/92/2021/0/HF/94/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Version read: introduced text (as filed). Paragraph (e) is the part that deals with renewals; the rest of the subdivision is existing law kept in the section.

operative_text: Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 3): (e) Applications for new permits must be submitted in person. Applications for permit renewals may be accepted in person, electronically, or by United States mail, at the sheriff's discretion.
